description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into small end-to-end issues, each one a vertical slice that names the issues blocking it, then publish them to the project's issue tracker after the user approves the breakdown. Use on request only: "break this into issues", "turn this plan into tickets", "split this up so agents can pick it up". For writing the plan first, use the plan-change skill.
